# PipSePaisa

> PipSePaisa is a Forex education and trading-tools platform focused on structured learning, broker reviews, mentor-led education, practical market resources, and responsible trading.

## Main public pages
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/ — Forex trading education, courses and trading tools
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/courses/ — Forex trading courses
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/broker-reviews/ — Forex broker reviews and comparisons
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/tradingtools/ — Forex trading tools and calculators
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/becomepartner/ — Forex IB partner program
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/mentors/ — Forex mentors and instructors
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/mentors/sajid-khan-ghori/ — Sajid Khan Ghori
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/mentors/ghulam-abbas/ — Malik Ghulam Abbas
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/about-us/ — About PipSePaisa
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/contact/ — Contact and support
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/risk-disclaimer/ — Forex trading risk disclaimer
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/terms-and-conditions/ — Terms and Conditions
- https://www.pipsepaisa.com/privacy-policy/ — Privacy Policy

PipSePaisa content is educational and does not constitute personal financial advice. Trading involves risk.
